title: 快乐数判断
description: 反复把 $n$ 换成它各位数字的平方和，若最终变成 1 输出 YES，否则输出 NO。

solutions.python:
import sys

data = sys.stdin.read().split()
n0 = int(data[0])
seen = set()
x = n0
while x != 1 and x not in seen:
    seen.add(x)
    s = 0
    while x:
        s += (x % 10) ** 2
        x //= 10
    x = s
print("YES" if x == 1 else "NO")
